# hiok_servicebus_subscription (Resource)

A subscription to a Service Bus topic.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `namespace_id` (String)
- `topic` (String) Topic name.

### Optional

- `dead_lettering_enabled` (Boolean)
- `forward_dead_lettered_to` (String)
- `forward_to` (String) Queue or topic to forward messages to.
- `lock_duration_seconds` (Number) Default: the API's.
- `max_delivery_count` (Number) Default: the API's.
- `message_ttl_seconds` (Number) Default: the API's.
- `requires_session` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
